About the job

Company: Groveda (A Venture by GGPL Groveda Global Pvt. Ltd.)

Location: Ahmedabad (On-site / Hybrid)

Experience: 1–5 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Candidate: Ahmedabad Location only preferred


About Groveda

Groveda is a next-generation health & wellness e-commerce platform focused on trust, transparency, and clean-label products. We are building a curated marketplace for herbal, organic, and nutraceutical products with a mission to shift consumers from discount-driven buying to trust-driven buying.


Role Overview

We are looking for a creative and performance-driven Front-End Developer who can build a high-converting, fast, and intuitive user experience for our e-commerce platform.

You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to create a seamless and engaging customer journey—from homepage to checkout.


Key Responsibilities

1. UI Development

  • Develop responsive, pixel-perfect UI using modern frameworks
  • Convert Figma/Design mockups into high-quality code
  • Ensure cross-browser and cross-device compatibility

2. E-Commerce Experience Optimization

  • Build high-conversion pages (Product Pages, Cart, Checkout)
  • Implement features like:
  • Trust badges
  • Ingredient transparency sections
  • “What’s NOT Inside” highlights
  • Product comparison modules

3. Performance Optimization

  • Optimize page load speed and Core Web Vitals
  • Implement lazy loading, code splitting, and caching strategies

4. Integration

  • Integrate APIs with backend systems
  • Work with payment gateways, inventory APIs, and analytics tools

5. UX & Conversion Focus

  • Improve UI/UX based on customer behavior
  • Work on A/B testing and conversion optimization

6. Code Quality & Maintenance

  • Write clean, scalable, and reusable code
  • Follow best practices and version control (Git)
  • Debug and fix frontend issues


Required Skills


Core Technologies

  • HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+)
  • React.js / Next.js (preferred)
  • Tailwind CSS / Bootstrap
  • Magento 2 CMS
  • Mysql/postgresql


E-Commerce Knowledge

  • Experience with Shopify / Magento 2 / Custom E-commerce
  • Understanding of checkout flows and conversion funnels


Tools & Platforms

  • Git / GitHub
  • Figma / Adobe XD
  • API Integration (REST / GraphQL)


Performance & SEO

  • Knowledge of Core Web Vitals
  • Basic SEO principles for frontend


Good to Have

  • Experience in health, wellness, or FMCG brands
  • Knowledge of Headless Commerce
  • Experience with analytics tools (Google Analytics, Hotjar)
  • Understanding of UI psychology & conversion design


What We Are Looking For

  • A problem solver, not just a coder
  • Someone who understands customer behavior
  • A mindset of “design for trust, not just aesthetics”
  • Passion for building a premium, global brand experience


What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to build a global wellness brand from ground up
  • Fast-growth, entrepreneurial environment
  • Direct exposure to leadership and strategic decisions
  • Competitive salary + performance incentives
